newsitem.title: USA: Dresser, Stolt set asset exchange.
newsitem.headline: Dresser, Stolt set asset exchange.

text.p: Sub Sea Offshore Ltd said Thursday it has a letter of intent with Stolt Comex Seaway to exchange a part of Sub Sea's diving business assets in the North Sea for Stolt Comex Seaway's survey business and assets in Norway.

The exchange will occur at the end of the 1997 North Sea construction season to avoid any disruption to ongoing activities. Sub Sea, a Dresser Industries Inc subsidiary, said it will fulfill commitments beyond 1997 with its remaining diving assets.

President Brent Ford said, "This proposed transaction represents another step toward rationalizing our portfolio and focusing on our core businesses. Through our unique capabilities in remote technology and our association with other Dresser affiliates, we intend to be the world's leader in deepwater installation solutions."

He also noted that, "Once this transaction is completed Sub Sea and Stolt Comex Seaway will offer each other complementary services allowing each of us to provide comprehensive services to our customers in offshore markets."
